title: Overwatch Retail Patch Notes - June 18, 2026
title_cn: 《守望先锋》正式服更新说明 - 2026年6月18日
note:
### Overwatch Retail Patch Notes - June 18, 2026

#### Bug Fix Patch

This is a Bug Fix Patch. Replay codes have NOT been wiped.

#### Bug Fixes - General Game Updates

* Resolved an issue with Shion's Joyride leaving collision behind for a period of time after throwing it at an enemy
* Resolved an issue with Kiriko's Ofuda range being set to the incorrect value
* Fixed an instance of Ramattra's Void Barrier's cooldown incorrectly resetting
* Fixed a bug with Shion's Joyride that allowed for bypassing of some animations
* Fixed bugs related to Domina's Corporate Retreat
* Resolved an issue that allowed Shion quick melee to be used during Satsuriku Spree

#### Bug Fixes - Stadium Updates

* Fixed an issue where Aerial Distresser was procing Ashe's Calamity Power more than intended.
* Fixed an issue where when using Tracer's Temportal Power, Interacting and Recalling at the same time would reset Recall's cooldown.
* Fixed an issue where healing from Winston's Surge Protector Power would continue longer than intended if Pocket Projector is active.
* Fixed an issue where Moira's Extendrils item prevented Ethereal Excision from granting bonus damage or healing.
* Fixed an issue where Three Tap Tommygun's DOT counted as Critical Hits for Cassidy's Bullseye Power and Kiriko's Keen Kunai Power.
* Fixed an issue where using Swift Strike right after Genji's Dragon Strike Item made players unable to use the rest of Dragon Blade.
* Fixed an issue where Sojourn's Overclocked Surge stats were not functional.
note_cn:
### 《守望先锋》正式服更新说明 - 2026年6月18日

#### 错误修复补丁

这是一个错误修复补丁。回放代码尚未失效。

#### 错误修复 - 游戏常规更新

* 修复了死怨的“兜风”在掷向敌人后的一段时间内会残留碰撞体积的问题
* 修复了雾子的御札范围被设定为错误数值的问题
* 修复了拉玛刹“虚空屏障”冷却时间错误重置的问题
* 修复了死怨的“兜风”允许跳过部分动画的错误
* 修复了与金驭的“企业团建”相关的错误
* 修复了死怨在“杀戮狂欢”期间可以使用快速近战的问题

#### 错误修复 - 角斗领域更新

* 修复了“空中遇险装置”触发艾什“灾厄”异能次数超出预期的问题。
* 修复了使用猎空的“时空门”异能时，同时进行互动和“闪回”会重置“闪回”冷却时间的问题。
* 修复了如果“便携发射器”处于激活状态，温斯顿“电涌保护器”异能的治疗效果持续时间会超出预期的问题。
* 修复了莫伊拉的“增生触须”物品导致“虚灵切除”无法提供额外输出或治疗的问题。
* 修复了“三连发汤米枪”的持续伤害（DOT）被卡西迪的“靶心”异能和雾子的“锐利苦无”异能判定为暴击的问题。
* 修复了在源氏的“龙击”物品后立即使用“影”会导致玩家无法使用剩余的“斩”的问题。
* 修复了索杰恩“超频涌动”属性未能生效的问题。
